item.title: Vistor's Center to Highway 25 — Mon Oct 19, 9:00 AM
item.description:

item.description:

item.title: Foster Creek Preserve; a Saunter — Sat Oct 24, 9:45 AM
item.description: Hendo Fun Friends Sometimes even the most benign little trail can be filled with wondrous surprises. Nestled in a small valley in North Mills River, North Carolina, and surrounded by Pisgah National Forest, the Foster Creek conservation easement is covered with a soft, cushioned pine straw bed and lined with wildflowers, ferns, and fungus, and a rare Southern Appalachian bog and nearly 300 species of plants and animals also find safe harbor on this land. Remember - hikes led by ‘the Curmudgeon’ tend to have pleasant surprises. Difficulty: Easy, if you can handle the distance & climb. Well developed trail – earthen & forest road. 1 moderate short climb in the beginning. **Wood elves are mischievous; zip your bags tight..** We are the **Sloth Hike Team of WNC**: “We will get there when we get there.” We dare to go where the ‘real’ hike groups don’t ***!!*** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Bsh_8qxUfDY **Hike Details:** **Social ‘hour’ at 9:45 AM. item.title: Scenic AVL #7: Scott Mountain — Sat Oct 31, 8:30 AM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group There is very limited parking at the [trailhead](https://maps.app.goo.gl/fETct2fiMiLz1HEG8). Please plan to meet at Lake Hills Church parking lot at 10 minutes before the start to condense cars. We will meet in the parking lot area close to the intersection of Lake Drive and Black Midge lane.
Lake Hills Church Parking Lot is pictured above. - [https://maps.app.goo.gl/X1TctrhYv3gihmh66](https://maps.app.goo.gl/X1TctrhYv3gihmh66) *Call the hike leader at 828-290-0886 if you cannot find us. Do not text.
**Rating**: Moderate **Elevation**: 800 **Distance**: 5 miles **Surface**: Trail **Pace**: 3 mph **Dogs**: on leash. **Gear**: Long pants recommended, bug spray, water. The ticks are bad on this trail. Bring your bug spray ! **Features**: wooded trail, interesting plants and fungi. Bears are shy, but we may see them, also deer and squirrels. 3 miles uphill, 2.25 down. **All Trails Route**: [Scott Mountain Loop on AllTrails](https://www.alltrails.com/explore/map

item.title: Final Month - Sonic Journey Through Sound — Sat Nov 7, 3:00 PM
item.description:
Inner Peace Collective Somatic Sounds is moving to South FL in Dec. This will be the final month for sessions. **I want to Thank Asheville for all the support!**
[Every Weekend @ 11am & 3pm](https://somaticsounds.net/events/) **\* $26 to reserve please use the event link** [https://somaticsounds.net/events/](https://somaticsounds.net/events/)
Sonic Journey Through Sound Come experience a somatic journey where ancient wisdom meets modern well-being — a multidimensional soundscape, richer and more textured than a traditional sound bath. Vivek guides each session with over 40 handcrafted singing bowls, layered with binaural beats to support deep relaxation and nervous system regulation. Participants leave feeling settled in the body and quiet in the mind.
Yoga mats, pillows, and blankets are provided.
This event is open to all levels—whether you’re a seasoned mindfulness enthusiast, exploring a novel path to relaxation, or simply seeking stress relief.
\*\* $26 to Reserve a spot plea

item.title: Fun & easy way to play more tennis (please read event description for details) — Sat Nov 7, 7:00 PM
item.description:
PlayYourCourt Asheville Tennis We’re still working to get more people into these Meetups, but our goal is to give PlayYourCourt members a few social tennis outings each week in addition to your practice sessions and Challenge League matches.
These Meetups are co-ed, super laid back, and all skill levels are welcome. Post your skill level and a suggested court in the comments section so we can round up as many players as we can for some tennis fun!
Also, if you’re looking to meet new practice partners or play some matches and you aren’t already in the PlayYourCourt Community, you can go here to see what we’re all about and sign up:
https://www.playyourcourt.com/tennis-community/asheville-nc/meetup/
If you love tennis, we’d love to have you! Be sure and watch the quick video that explains how everything works.
Happy hitting!
- Scott
Source: PlayYourCourt Asheville Tennis

item.title: Shut Up & Write - South Asheville — Sun Nov 8, 10:30 AM
item.description:
Shut Up & Write!® Western North Carolina Coworking for writers in your area! Join us for some focused writing time. All writers and all experience levels are welcome and don’t worry, no one will see what you've written. This session is about getting your writing done and meeting other writers in your area.
Please arrive a few minutes early to say hello to everyone, grab a drink, and get your writing tools ready. Once everyone’s arrived, I will lead quick introductions and then set the timer for our quiet and focused writing session.
Afterward, we’ll have time to chat and get to know each other. We often talk about our successes and challenges as writers. If you don’t have time to stick around, no worries!
A note about the format We don’t host critiques or readings. These events are a safe space for writers of all skill levels and genres to work on their craft, so no one will read or critique your writing.
For our full event schedule, visit https://shutupwrite.com

item.title: Strawberry Gap and Trombatore trails, 10 mile Fitness Hike. — Wed Oct 21, 9:30 AM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group **This will be a strenuous out and back hike of about 10.1 miles and 2,400 feet of elevation gain ( level 8\*) as we hike up the Eastern Contential Divide**. We will pass through thick rhododendrons and mountain laurels, pass large boulders and experience long-range views at Ferguson Peak and the Blue Ridge Pasture, and continue with a forest hike on the Trombatore Trail. We begin with a steep climb on the well-maintained Strawberry Gap trail. At \~2.5 miles, we will enter the open Blue Ridge Pastures for long range views and connect to the Trombatore forest trail. We will turn around at the end of the Trombatore Trail after a snack/water break.
**PACE**: This hike will be at a brisk pace (between 2.5-3 mi/hr) adjusting for steepness of grade and/or rugged trail conditions, brief regrouping as needed. This 10 mile level 8 fitness oriented hike of 2400 feet gain is for conditioned hikers. Join us If you like fitness oriented hike workouts.
